description: Download (or refresh) the signed IterxAI cloud parts catalog (~10 MB, the same catalog the desktop app uses). Call it when search_parts/get_part fail with PARTS_CATALOG_SYNCING or warn PARTS_CATALOG_STALE; it may take a few minutes on a slow link. Needs a signed-in IterxAI account like every iterx tool.

refresh.description: Force a full re-download even if the cache is current.

name: sync_parts_catalog
